findings.highlight: Tohsaka ponders as she eats my lunch
findings.evidenceJa: 思案げな風で、人の弁当をつつく遠坂
findings.governingReading: Rin pokes at Shirou’s lunch with a thoughtful air
findings.explanation: A specific contemplative gesture becomes simultaneous abstract pondering and eating.

findings.highlight: She came to the rooftop empty-handed
findings.evidenceJa: 今日も手ぶらで屋上に来ていた
findings.governingReading: today again, she came to the roof empty-handed
findings.explanation: The recurring “again today” pattern disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 唯一の食料である俺の弁当
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s lunch, the sole available food supply
findings.explanation: The mock-survival framing of Rin targeting the only food disappears.

findings.highlight: in case you had boxed lunch
findings.evidenceJa: お弁当だった時
findings.governingReading: in case he had brought a boxed lunch
findings.explanation: mirror moon produces ungrammatical count-noun English.

findings.highlight: you’re putting thought into the wrong areas
findings.evidenceJa: 用意周到さは、どこか論点がズレてる
findings.governingReading: her thorough preparation somehow misses the point
findings.explanation: A logical mismatch becomes awkward spatial wording about areas of thought.

findings.highlight: Bring some food before you bring chopsticks
findings.evidenceJa: 箸の前に食料を持ってこい、モノを
findings.governingReading: bring food before chopsticks—food
findings.explanation: The emphatic repetition and ruby-backed thing/food joke disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜が用意したおかずの量が多すぎた
findings.governingReading: Sakura prepared far too large a quantity of side dishes
findings.explanation: Both what Sakura made and the excess as a matter of portioning disappear.

findings.highlight: I won’t be able to finish it by myself
findings.evidenceJa: 俺一人じゃ食いきれなかった
findings.governingReading: he could not have finished it by himself
findings.explanation: The retrospective justification becomes a future prediction despite the meal already underway.

findings.highlight: I’ll get an upset stomach if I just eat meat
findings.evidenceJa: 肉食ってたら胃にもたれる
findings.governingReading: eating all the meat himself will sit heavily in his stomach
findings.explanation: Digestive heaviness becomes illness.

findings.evidenceJa: そのから揚げ
findings.governingReading: that karaage
findings.explanation: The specific fried chicken Rin refuses disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 味付け甘いから苦手
findings.governingReading: she dislikes its sweet seasoning
findings.explanation: The source identifies seasoning and personal dislike; the English makes the food categorically too sweet.

findings.highlight: I’m keeping track of how much I’ve eaten
findings.evidenceJa: 自分で分量計ってる
findings.governingReading: she measures her own portions
findings.explanation: Prospective portion control becomes retrospective calorie-like tracking.

findings.highlight: that’s a sign that I’ve had my share
findings.evidenceJa: 食べないってコトはストップサイン
findings.governingReading: her refusal to eat is itself a stop signal
findings.explanation: Rin’s asserted boundary becomes an inference about already consuming an allotted share.

findings.evidenceJa: わんこ蕎麦を食すが如きに霜降りカルビを食べる
findings.governingReading: eating marbled kalbi as though it were endlessly served wanko soba
findings.explanation: The centerpiece comparison and its absurd serving rhythm disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 霜降りカルビ
findings.governingReading: marbled kalbi
findings.explanation: The prized fatty cut central to the extravagance is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: その量、その勢いたるや
findings.governingReading: such would be the quantity and momentum of her eating
findings.explanation: The two dimensions escalating Rin’s imagined appetite disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: ちまちま塩辛つまんでる
findings.governingReading: nibbling miserably at shiokara
findings.explanation: A named fermented accompaniment and Shirou’s tiny, constrained eating are generalized.

findings.highlight: I try to get back at her for what she said earlier
findings.evidenceJa: さっきの仕返し、負け惜しみのつもりで軽口を叩く
findings.governingReading: he tosses off the quip as retaliation and sour-grapes bravado
findings.explanation: The English keeps revenge but loses the self-aware sore-loser framing and light delivery.

findings.highlight: the wrapping and all is really feminine
findings.evidenceJa: 盛り付けとかラッピングとか女の子っぽい
findings.governingReading: the arrangement and wrapping look feminine
findings.explanation: One of the two visual cues that lets Rin infer another cook disappears.

findings.highlight: I think I heard the same exact thing this morning
findings.evidenceJa: そんなようなコトを、朝方も言われた気がする
findings.governingReading: he feels he was told something similar that morning
findings.explanation: A tentative resemblance becomes exact identity.

findings.evidenceJa: 気まずそうに弁当から離れる
findings.governingReading: Rin withdraws awkwardly from the lunch
findings.explanation: A socially uncomfortable retreat becomes wording suggestive of escape.

findings.highlight: nervous eating lunch next to Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂と肩をつきあわせて食事をとる、という事に緊張
findings.governingReading: tense at the prospect of eating shoulder to shoulder with Rin
findings.explanation: The bodily closeness causing Shirou’s tension is generalized to adjacency.

findings.highlight: Now I can enjoy a little peace of mind
findings.evidenceJa: これでゆっくり食べられる
findings.governingReading: now he can eat at ease and take his time
findings.explanation: A practical change in the meal becomes a vague psychological benefit.

findings.highlight: students go to a different floor to eat
findings.evidenceJa: 違う学年に赴く生徒
findings.governingReading: students crossing into another grade’s area during lunch
findings.explanation: The social boundary between grades becomes movement between floors, and eating is added.

findings.highlight: the stairs are quiet and empty
findings.evidenceJa: 階段にはちらほらとしか人影はない
findings.governingReading: only scattered figures appear on the stairs
findings.explanation: A sparsely occupied stairwell becomes completely empty.

findings.evidenceJa: まるっきり元気がない
findings.governingReading: Sakura has no energy at all
findings.explanation: A visible lack of vitality becomes a diagnosed emotional state.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂はそんなコトを口にした
findings.governingReading: Rin steps forward and voices that apology
findings.explanation: The movement remains, but the narration’s emphasis that Rin deliberately says it is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしから衛宮くんを呼びつけた
findings.governingReading: Rin summoned or called Shirou out herself
findings.explanation: Her forceful responsibility for bringing him is softened into a friendly invitation.

findings.highlight: The range is open during lunchtime
findings.evidenceJa: お昼なら道場も空いてます
findings.governingReading: the archery dojo is empty at lunch
findings.explanation: Physical emptiness and privacy become institutional availability.

findings.evidenceJa: 誰もいないから静か
findings.governingReading: it is quiet because nobody is there
findings.explanation: The privacy Sakura is offering and its causal relation disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: まだ封を開けていない弁当箱
findings.governingReading: Sakura is holding a lunchbox whose seal has not yet been opened
findings.explanation: A concrete proof of not eating becomes the broader and less visual “untouched.”

findings.evidenceJa: なにを聞いてたんだ俺は
findings.governingReading: what had he been listening to
findings.explanation: Shirou’s failure to hear Sakura’s invitation becomes general bad judgment.

findings.evidenceJa: 馬鹿だのコイツ呼ばわりされる
findings.governingReading: call him an idiot and refer to him as “this guy”
findings.explanation: Half of Rin’s abrasive wording and Shirou’s self-mockery disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 間抜けにも程がある
findings.governingReading: there is a limit to how obliviously foolish one can be
findings.explanation: The idiomatic extremity of Shirou’s self-reproach is weakened.

findings.highlight: I just thought it might be good if we could eat together
findings.evidenceJa: そうなったらいいなって思っただけ
findings.governingReading: she only hoped things might turn out that way
findings.explanation: The English makes Sakura state the specific shared meal more explicitly than her guarded reference does.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の冷静なつっこみ
findings.governingReading: Rin’s calm comic correction or retort
findings.explanation: The comic conversational function becomes abstract analysis.

findings.evidenceJa: いまので十分嬉しかった
findings.governingReading: what he just did made her more than happy enough
findings.explanation: Sakura’s stated happiness disappears into a generic judgment of sufficiency.

findings.highlight: when she makes a face like that
findings.evidenceJa: そんな顔で
findings.governingReading: with that expression
findings.explanation: The English makes Sakura actively “make a face,” lending it an affected quality.

findings.evidenceJa: 学校が終わったら、すぐに
findings.governingReading: immediately once school ends
findings.explanation: The urgency of Rin’s instruction disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: そこで待ってるから
findings.governingReading: Rin will be waiting there for him
findings.explanation: The person who waits is reversed from Rin to Shirou.

findings.evidenceJa: 謎の言い付け
findings.governingReading: a mysterious instruction or order
findings.explanation: Rin’s directive force becomes informational content.

findings.highlight: There’s nothing I can do here
findings.evidenceJa: 校舎に残ってもやる事はない
findings.governingReading: even if he remains in the school building, there is nothing to do
findings.explanation: The conditional choice about staying at school becomes absolute inability in the present place.

findings.evidenceJa: 当たって砕けろの精神で
findings.governingReading: with a spirit of charging in even if he crashes and burns
findings.explanation: Shirou’s reluctant, idiomatic resolve disappears.
